reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Translate verified offer and audience evidence into an unlaunched set of paid-ad concepts, copy variants, production briefs, and learning hypotheses.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare an evidence-bound paid-ad creative batch for review
turn approved positioning into testable ad concepts without spending or publishing
operations: select angles, draft variants, specify assets, preserve claims, and define learning hypotheses
outputs: unpublished ad-creative package with provenance, variants, and test rationale
failureBehavior: stop on missing proof, rights, budget authority, or current placement requirements
usefulInvariants: production and launch are separate effects

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Shape a short-form script around a truthful opening promise, timed escalation, payoff, native format, and explicit retention hypothesis.
neutralIntentExamples: draft several testable short-form openings for an approved idea
reshape a vertical-video script while preserving its promised payoff
operations: select a hook, time beats, align text and sound, preserve payoff, and define a comparison
outputs: unpublished short-form script variants with timing and measurement notes
failureBehavior: label platform claims as hypotheses and refuse virality guarantees
usefulInvariants: the opening promise is paid off

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Route B2B paid-network questions across audience, bidding, campaign, creative, measurement, and optimization specialists.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare a bounded B2B paid-network strategy from verified account evidence
route a paid-network diagnosis to the smallest relevant specialist
operations: classify the paid-media problem, select specialists, reconcile recommendations, and stage account changes
outputs: unlaunched strategy or diagnosis with authority gates and evidence gaps
failureBehavior: defer when live data, provider access, current benchmarks, or mutation authority is missing
usefulInvariants: strategy and live mutation stay separate

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Aggregate current market news, social discussion, analyst, institutional, insider, and short-interest evidence into a financial sentiment scorecard.
neutralIntentExamples: analyze sourced market sentiment without issuing a trade instruction
compare dated market narratives and positioning evidence for a ticker
operations: collect dated evidence, score dimensions, reconcile contradictions, and state uncertainty
outputs: financial-market sentiment report with caveats and provenance
failureBehavior: leave dimensions unknown rather than fabricating sparse or stale data

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Route a broad marketing mission across audit, positioning, copy, launch, search, social, advertising, email, and measurement modules.
neutralIntentExamples: decompose a multi-surface marketing mission into bounded specialist work
produce a scored marketing artifact while exposing assumptions and evidence gaps
operations: classify the mission, fan out bounded analyses, score artifacts, remove unsupported claims, and reconcile outputs
outputs: marketing work package with scores, artifacts, gaps, and next decisions
failureBehavior: defer specialist effects and current claims when evidence or authority is unavailable
exclusions: treating one router as a universal skill

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Turn authorized product captures into planned horizontal and vertical promo-video masters through cost-gated generation and deterministic assembly.
neutralIntentExamples: storyboard a product demo video from real captures before spending generation credits
assemble approved product footage into reproducible horizontal and vertical masters
operations: extract visual evidence, storyboard, estimate cost, generate approved shots, assemble, and inspect
outputs: promo-video plan, generation ledger, and verified master variants
failureBehavior: stop before paid generation without approval and resume idempotently from recorded shot state

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Compress a verified source report into platform-native drafts and optional visual summaries without changing its evidence or verdicts.
neutralIntentExamples: adapt a finished analysis into distinct unpublished channel drafts
turn verified findings into a carousel brief without changing numbers or nuance
operations: extract findings, select platform structures, preserve exact evidence, draft variants, and specify optional visuals
outputs: unpublished channel package and optional evidence-linked carousel specification
failureBehavior: omit unsupported branding or calls to action and stop when the source cannot support compression
usefulInvariants: each channel receives a native form
materialRisks: visual polish can overstate weak evidence

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Draft short original quote options aligned to approved source material, then prepare a visual-production brief for the selected line.
neutralIntentExamples: derive several concise original quote lines from an approved caption
prepare an accessible quote-card brief without false attribution
operations: extract the durable idea, draft concise variants, check voice and attribution, and brief the visual
outputs: original quote options and an unexecuted visual brief
failureBehavior: reject false attribution and defer image generation without tools, rights, or approval
usefulInvariants: the line remains original or correctly attributed
visual production is a separate effect

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Route a banner mission into art direction, asset generation, layout, export, and visual verification for a declared placement.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare several brand-grounded banner directions for a known placement
produce and verify a social banner from approved assets and exact dimensions
operations: select art directions, brief assets, compose, export variants, and inspect fidelity
outputs: banner concepts or verified banner assets with production evidence
failureBehavior: defer generation or export when brand evidence, dimensions, tools, or rights are missing

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Write platform-aware captions, on-screen text, and calls to action that preserve the content promise and avoid coercive engagement tactics.
neutralIntentExamples: draft concise caption variants that preserve an approved video claim
improve a call to action without manufacturing urgency or bait
operations: front-load meaning, align on-screen and caption text, choose a bounded call to action, and check accessibility
outputs: unpublished caption, text-overlay, and call-to-action variants
failureBehavior: remove unsupported platform claims and coercive engagement language
usefulInvariants: the caption preserves the source promise

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Design a timed short-form opening by aligning visual surprise, sound, text, promise, payoff, and a retention hypothesis.
neutralIntentExamples: create testable vertical-video opening concepts from an approved story
brief a short-form hook in Chinese while preserving claim and payoff
operations: choose an opening mechanism, time the first beat, align modalities, preserve payoff, and define variants
outputs: short-form opening brief with timed variants and measurement hypothesis
failureBehavior: strip vendor-specific or unsupported virality claims and defer specialist generation
usefulInvariants: the opening promise is paid off

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Review a professional-network outreach campaign against activity, brevity, cadence, timezone, consent, and stopping constraints.
neutralIntentExamples: audit a professional-network contact sequence before any messages are sent
check whether an outreach plan is bounded, relevant, and respectful
operations: check targeting, brevity, cadence, timing, value, follow-up limits, and authority
outputs: preflight findings and unpublished remediation plan
failureBehavior: stop when consent, account authority, live limits, or activity evidence is unavailable
usefulInvariants: platform action is a separate effect

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Validate and compare social performance data through explicit metric definitions, source provenance, time windows, uncertainty, and decision-linked findings.
neutralIntentExamples: audit social performance from verified post-level data
compare channel outcomes without inventing engagement value or universal benchmarks
inputs: spend and revenue evidence when applicable
operations: validate data, calculate declared metrics, qualify comparisons, identify patterns, and expose missing evidence
outputs: measurement report with formulas, provenance, confidence, and bounded recommendations
failureBehavior: leave ROI or benchmark comparisons unknown when revenue, definitions, or current evidence is missing

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Prepare a thumbnail concept and generation brief from a video's truthful promise, visual evidence, identity, and placement constraints.
neutralIntentExamples: derive several truthful thumbnail concepts from an approved video
brief a legible thumbnail without inventing faces, outcomes, or product states
operations: extract the promise, select visual hierarchy, draft variants, brief production, and inspect legibility
outputs: thumbnail concepts or verified asset variants with source linkage
failureBehavior: defer generation when source images, identity rights, tools, or dimensions are unresolved
exclusions: clickbait that breaks the content promise
usefulInvariants: the thumbnail promise matches the content

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Compose a high-contrast quote or data card from real content while preserving authorship, brand, dimensions, and screenshot-ready hierarchy.
neutralIntentExamples: turn a verified insight into a branded share-card specification
create a legible data card using real numbers and attribution
operations: select card type, compose hierarchy, apply restrained texture, verify attribution, and inspect at target size
outputs: share-card specification or verified visual asset
failureBehavior: retain placeholders or stop when data, authorship, brand, or visual tooling is unresolved

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Evaluate a draft against the author's verified voice and historical performance patterns while separating descriptive evidence from causal claims.
neutralIntentExamples: review a draft against a source-labeled author performance profile
identify evidence-backed revision options without pretending engagement predicts truth
operations: derive a comparison profile, score declared dimensions, qualify uncertainty, and propose evidence-linked revisions
outputs: draft scorecard, comparison evidence, and revision options
failureBehavior: fall back transparently or stop before paid scraping when author data and authority are missing
exclusions: universal fallback benchmarks presented as personal
usefulInvariants: personal evidence remains distinguishable from fallback guidance

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Derive a compact identity and writing-voice contract from a bounded interview and multiple representative samples, including observed absences and contradictions.
neutralIntentExamples: build a reusable voice profile from representative writing samples
extract positive and negative voice constraints without inventing patterns
operations: interview, compare samples, extract recurring and absent signals, reconcile contradictions, and write compact contracts
outputs: identity context and evidence-grounded voice profile
failureBehavior: request more representative evidence and mark contradictions instead of smoothing or inventing them
usefulInvariants: absence claims cite the sample set
identity and writing mechanics remain distinct

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Configure time-windowed vector-database collections and rotation policies for bounded data retention and query performance.
neutralIntentExamples: design a sliding-window vector retention policy
configure collection rotation for time-bounded embeddings
operations: partition collections by time, rotate aliases, expire data, and verify query continuity
outputs: vector-database retention design and operational runbook
failureBehavior: defer deployment when retention, deletion, or infrastructure authority is unresolved

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Design a paid-media experiment ledger with hypotheses, sample requirements, observation windows, decision rules, and iteration order.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare a bounded paid-media test plan from actual traffic and economics
define winner criteria and stop conditions before changing an ad campaign
operations: prioritize variables, estimate samples, define hypotheses and windows, stage tests, and record decisions
outputs: unexecuted paid-media experiment roadmap and testing ledger
failureBehavior: reject underpowered tests and defer account changes without live authority

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Plan an account-based paid-media program by reconciling account selection, budget capacity, campaign structure, sales coordination, and measurement.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare an unlaunched account-based advertising plan from authorized company evidence
estimate whether a paid account program has enough budget and evidence to proceed
operations: size the account set, segment intent, model budget, define campaign and sales handoffs, and set measurement gates
outputs: account-based strategy, budget model, handoff contract, and unresolved risks
failureBehavior: stop on missing targeting rights, budget, identity matching, tracking, or execution authority

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Architect a multi-stage paid-acquisition funnel across awareness, consideration, conversion, retargeting, instrumentation, budget, and implementation sequencing.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare an unlaunched paid funnel from verified offer and economics
map paid-channel stages, audiences, assets, and measurement without changing live accounts
operations: select channels, map stages, define audiences and assets, allocate provisional budget, instrument metrics, and sequence launch gates
outputs: unlaunched paid-funnel architecture, budget model, asset map, and implementation plan
failureBehavior: preserve unknown platform, tracking, budget, and targeting assumptions and stop before live mutation

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Map an organization's external attack surface from passive public intelligence under written security authorization.
neutralIntentExamples: conduct authorized passive reconnaissance for a security assessment
inventory externally visible assets from public security sources
operations: enumerate public infrastructure, personnel, leaks, and technology evidence and compile risk findings
outputs: authorized external-reconnaissance report and remediation priorities
failureBehavior: stop outside written scope or when passive collection would become active testing or personal surveillance
usefulInvariants: passive and active effects remain distinct

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Shape a vertical-video concept around a truthful opening, escalating visual beats, payoff, accessibility, and a measurable retention hypothesis.
neutralIntentExamples: adapt an approved story into several testable vertical-video scripts
diagnose a short-form draft against its promise, pacing, and payoff
operations: select an opening, map timed beats, align modalities, preserve payoff, and design variants
outputs: unpublished short-form script and production brief variants

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Design authorized paid-network audience segments, exclusions, and remarketing pools from company, role, intent, and first-party evidence.

operations: segment audiences, define exclusions, estimate scale, map remarketing windows, and stage upload gates
outputs: unuploaded audience map with provenance, privacy controls, and launch checks

neutralIntentExamples: model paid-network bid options without applying live account changes
